subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined word in the given sentence.

A newer, more effective computer system was installed in place of the __obsolete__ one.
solution:
The correct answer is: **outdated**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"obsolete"** means something that is no longer in use or has become out of date due to being replaced by something newer and more efficient. (अप्रचलित)

 
 
• **Example: **Typewriters have become obsolete with the advent of computers.
 
 
 
• **"Outdated" **refers to something that is old-fashioned or no longer useful because it has been replaced by something newer and more modern. (पुराना)
 
 
• **Example: **The software was outdated and needed to be upgraded to the latest version.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the word "outdated" is an appropriate substitute for "obsolete".

Therefore, the correct answer is: **outdated**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Modern **(आधुनिक): Relating to the present or recent times as opposed to the remote past.

 
 
• **Example:** The building features a modern design with sleek lines and large windows.
 
 
 
• **Advanced **(उन्नत): Far on or ahead in development or progress.
 
 
• **Example: **Advanced technology has enabled us to connect with people across the globe instantaneously.
 
 
 
• **Current** (वर्तमान): Belonging to the present time; happening or being used or done now.
 
 
• **Example:** The current trend in fashion is leaning towards sustainability.
